name: recorder
description: The Talk screen's compact transport recorder (approved): a masthead with the wordmark and the date, a back row, the intro, and the recording sheet: a session line (state, date, the elapsed clock), the recording field with the waveform and its axis, and the controls (Start, Cancel and the microphone feedback before recording; Pause or Resume and Stop and keep while recording). Content decides its height. v4 C5: while paused the field is the player (the trace is the track) and Discard stands at the transport's far end, asking first; leaving keeps the memo as a draft.

phase.description: Which controls show: the start controls (ready), or the transport while a memo is under way (recording, paused); the runtime swaps them with hidden.

back.description: Where the wordmark, the back link and Cancel go: Today (the talk page passes the prototype link, 00-prototype.html#today).

draft.description: v4 C5: the memo is the voice memo draft, opened from Today (the mic or the Continue line): while paused the state line reads "Paused · draft" (data-draft).

playing.description: v4 C5, paused only: playback is running (data-playback="playing"): the play control shows pause.

confirm.description: v4 C5, paused only: Discard has been pressed: the question and its two buttons stand in the transport's place.

date.description: v4 C5: the session line's day, "Sun 9 Aug", never a time (ruling: a memo is dated when it is kept).

length.description: v4 C5: the memo's length so far, "0:47": the axis end and the player's length while paused, and the discard question.

seconds.description: v4 C5: the same length in seconds (the slider's maximum).

position.description: v4 C5, paused only: the player's place in seconds (0 at rest); above 0 the veil and playhead show (data-playback="started").

children.description: The masthead's date box and the controls' buttons.

trace.description: The trace's bars: the memo's fixed decorative shape (system/content/wave-shape.mjs traceBars), each a group carrying data-level, flat until a memo is under way. Without it, a flat line. It never follows the sound.

places.grow: the transport's main button: takes the room left below 620
places.discard: Discard in the transport: first in the markup, so the row-reverse transport sets it at the far end; below 620 last, under the hint; shown only while paused

exposes.--aj-s-recorder-at: The player's place, 0 to 1 (the veil's start and the playhead): the render sets it on the root from position and seconds, the runtime as it plays and seeks.

states.hover: n/a: a section is not a control; its controls carry their own
states.focus-visible: n/a: not focusable; its controls carry the ring
states.loading: n/a: asking for the microphone is its own state line (copy), not a style
states.error: yes: the microphone refused or missing: the state line says so and Try again shows

events.play: v4 C5: play or pause playback (paused only); Resume stops playback and records on from the end
events.skip: v4 C5: back or forward 10 s (data-skip)
events.seek: v4 C5: the track clicked, dragged or moved with its keys (arrows 5 s, Home, End; Space plays)
events.discard: v4 C5: Discard pressed: the question shows
events.discard-yes: v4 C5: Discard memo: back to Today with nothing kept
events.discard-no: v4 C5: Go back: the question goes and focus returns to Discard

a11y.role: main; the state line is role=status, the clock role=timer; v4 C5: while paused the track is role=slider (aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext "0:19 of 0:47"); the discard question is role=alertdialog
a11y.keyboard: Tab through the controls; v4 C5: on the track, arrows move 5 s (mirrored right to left), Home and End go to the ends, Space plays; the question takes focus on Go back
a11y.labels: the clock has an aria-label; the player's controls are labelled (Play back or Pause playback, Back 10 seconds, Forward 10 seconds)

responsive.336: the masthead and back row wrap; the transport buttons take the full width
responsive.620: the session line reflows into two rows; the controls stack, buttons first; v4 C5: the back note stays centred on its link; Discard goes last, under the hint

changelog.change: Writes what the Talk screens have: the prototype links (00-prototype.html#today), the microphone status id and the start button's aria-describedby, the hidden Try again button, and the microphone messages for the unavailable and waiting states (found by pages round 2, 03-talk).
Converted from lock.css (the compact transport recorder).
Option back (the link to Today); the start and retry buttons are the button module again (aria-describedby and hidden through attrs). Pages auth round.

RecommendedChanges-v4 B6: the trace is a fixed decorative shape (slot trace), not measured audio; phase recording. The rise to the shape on Start reads the motion scope (data-motion) and the wave tokens (--g-wave, --gc).
Keep this out of memory (the composer's option, opt) under the controls in every phase; the kept memo takes it.

v4 C5 (explore drafts a-quiet-line): the player while paused (track, veil, playhead, play / pause, skips, position / length; options playing and position), Discard and its question (option confirm), option draft ("Paused · draft"), content date (the day only), length and seconds; copy: leaving keeps the memo as a draft, Stop and keep adds it to today, the paused hint; the back note centred at every width.

data-recorder-phase.description: Where the capture is: ready to start, recording, paused.

data-microphone.description: The microphone's permission as the runtime last found it.

data-playback.description: v4 C5, paused only: playback has moved off the start (started) or is running (playing); without it the trace is drawn as recorded.

data-draft.description: v4 C5: the memo is the draft kept on the device.

hooks.data-recorder: On each control: its action (start, pause, keep, back, retry; v4 C5: play, skip, discard, discard-yes, discard-no); the runtime reads it on a press.
hooks.data-session-state: The session line's state text; the runtime writes it.
hooks.data-session-date: The session line's day; the runtime writes it (the day only, never a time: v4 C5).
hooks.data-recording-hint: The transport's hint line; the runtime writes it.
hooks.data-microphone-status: The microphone status line; the runtime writes it.
hooks.data-live-wave: The trace; on Start the runtime scales each bar to its data-level once (the fixed shape), and back to flat when the recorder reopens. It never follows the sound.
hooks.data-level: Each trace bar's height in the memo's fixed shape (system/content/wave-shape.mjs), read by the runtime on Start.
hooks.data-clock: The recording clock; the runtime writes it.
hooks.data-back-note: The note under the back control; the runtime writes it.
hooks.data-axis-end: The wave axis's end label; the runtime writes it.
hooks.start: The start block (shown before a capture begins); the runtime shows and hides it.
hooks.transport: The transport block (pause, resume, keep while recording); the runtime shows and hides it.
hooks.memory: Keep this out of memory (opt, data-hook="memory"): the runtime toggles aria-pressed and the kept memo is kept out of memory when it is pressed.
hooks.player: v4 C5: the player's controls row (play, the skips, position / length).
hooks.track: v4 C5: the track round the trace; while paused a slider the runtime moves (pointer and keys).
hooks.confirm: v4 C5: the discard question; the runtime shows and hides it (hidden).
hooks.data-skip: v4 C5: a skip control's seconds, -10 or 10.
hooks.data-position: v4 C5: the player's position text; the runtime writes it.
hooks.data-length: v4 C5: the memo's length, in the player and the question; the runtime writes it.
